tabs.title: Sidebar sections
tabs.body: Switch between lists of notes, such as My notes, Groups and Shared with me, with the tabs at the top of the sidebar. They show icons only; hover over one to see its name. Deleted notes go to the Trash first.
tabs.narrowBody: The tabs at the top of the sidebar switch between lists of notes, such as My notes, Groups and Shared with me. Deleted notes go to the Trash first. Open the sidebar from here.
tabs.phoneBody: This row of icons switches between lists of notes, such as My notes, Groups and Shared with me. Deleted notes go to the Trash first.

newNote.title: New note
newNote.body: Click here to create a note. It goes into My notes.
newNote.narrowBody: "New note" at the bottom of the sidebar creates a note in My notes. Open the sidebar from here.
newNote.phoneBody: Tap here to create a note. On a note, the new one goes in the same folder or group as that note; on the list, it goes into My notes.

folders.title: Folders
folders.body: Use this button in the My notes header to create a folder. A note's ⋮ menu has "Move to…" for putting it into a folder.
folders.narrowBody: You can create folders from the My notes header. A note's ⋮ menu has "Move to…" for putting it into a folder. Open the sidebar from here.
folders.phoneBody: Tap this button in the My notes header to create a folder. A note's ⋮ menu has "Move to…" for putting it into a folder.

search.title: Search
search.body: Press {{mod}}K to search. It finds titles and note text.
search.narrowBody: Press {{mod}}K to open the sidebar with the search box focused. It finds titles and note text. You can also open the sidebar from here.
search.phoneBody: Tap here to search. It finds titles and note text.

header.title: Share and more
header.body: "Share" invites others to view or edit. Switch the note between Standard, Wide and Full width with the icon next to Share or from ⋮ → "Width". The ⋮ menu also has "Present", "AI edit history", "Move to…" and "Copy to…".
header.phoneBody: "Share" invites others to view or edit. The ⋮ menu has "Present", "AI edit history", "Move to…", and "Copy to…".

versions.title: Version history
versions.body: Notes save versions automatically by default, and you can press {{mod}}S to save one yourself. Open the version history with this button in the bottom-right corner.
versions.phoneBody: Notes save versions automatically by default. "Version history" in the ⋮ menu opens the version history, where you can also save a version yourself.

knowledge.title: Knowledge info
knowledge.body: Type /info in a heading to note when to read it, a one-line conclusion and whether it is still current. This icon shows its state; point at it to see the details. My notes, folders and groups that hold knowledge each get an index of it.
knowledge.phoneBody: Type /info in a heading to note when to read it, a one-line conclusion and whether it is still current. This icon shows its state; tap it to see the details. My notes, folders and groups that hold knowledge each get an index of it.

tags.title: Tags
tags.body: Tag a note with "Add tag" in this ⋮ menu, by typing /tag, or by typing #name and a space on its first line when that line is a plain paragraph. Tags sit in a row above the text and show as colored dots in the sidebar. To list notes by tag, use the funnel button in the sidebar or type # in the search box.
tags.phoneBody: Tag a note with "Add tag" in this ⋮ menu, by typing /tag, or by typing #name and a space on its first line when that line is a plain paragraph. Tags sit in a row above the text and show as colored dots in the list. To list notes by tag, use the funnel button or type # in the search box.

wikilink.title: Link to another note
wikilink.body: Type [[ anywhere in a note and pick another note to link to it. The note you link to lists this one under "Mentioned in".

ai.title: Ask AI about a selection
ai.body: Select text and press the AI button in the toolbar that appears to have AI work on it. A sentence is already selected for you here.

slash.title: Insert blocks with /
slash.body: Type / to insert headings, lists, tables, diagrams and more, like the flowchart in this note. For side-by-side columns, pick "2 columns" (up to 4), or drag the ⋮⋮ beside a block to the left or right edge of another block. Drag the divider between columns to resize them.
slash.phoneBody: Type / to insert headings, lists, tables, diagrams and more, like the flowchart in this note.

userMenu.title: Forgot how something works?
userMenu.body: Press {{mod}}/ or open Help from here: shortcuts, the feature tour and what's new are all there, any time.
userMenu.narrowBody: Press {{mod}}/ or open Help from the menu at the bottom-left of the sidebar: shortcuts, the feature tour and what's new are all there, any time. Open the sidebar from here.
userMenu.phoneBody: Tap your avatar here and choose Help: shortcuts, the feature tour and what's new are all there, any time.

sample.title: Welcome to Knotebook
sample.intro: This note was made for the feature tour. You can edit it freely, then keep it or delete it at the end.
sample.heading: What a note can hold
sample.linkBefore: A link to this very note:
sample.aiSentence: Select this sentence to try AI.
sample.knowledgeWhen: When you are new to Knotebook
sample.knowledgeConclusion: A note can hold lists, tasks, quotes, code, links, columns, diagrams and tables.
